description: This file contains unit tests for iterator classes in the WPEFramework project, specifically testing iterator behavior over list and map containers with custom DataClass objects.

classes.name: DataClass
classes.description: A simple class encapsulating a uint8_t value, used for testing iterator behavior.

classes.name: IteratorClass
classes.description: A template class inheriting from Core::IteratorType, used to iterate over list containers.

classes.name: IteratorMapClass
classes.description: A template class inheriting from Core::IteratorMapType, used to iterate over map containers.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the iterator's current position and value against an expected index.

methods.name: ValidateMap
methods.description: Validates the map iterator's current position, value, and key against an expected index.
